snippet.title: Mike the Hooper Demo is out now!
snippet.description:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on a small solo project called Mike the Hooper.

It's a 2D puzzle-platformer where basketball is the main mechanic. In each level, your goal is to get the ball through the hoop to unlock the door and progress.

You'll need to think about angles, timing, and different obstacles to find the right shot.

The demo is around 15–20 minutes long, and I'd love to hear your feedback about the puzzles, difficulty, and overall feel of the game.

Thanks for checking it out!
